description:
> **Note:** The bushes appear green in the preview screenshots, but this has already been fixed in-game to match the map's current color palette

Dry Rift is a complete map texture rework for Summoner's Rift designed to eliminate visual noise and deliver a clean, arid battlefield. By neutralizing the dominant green channel across terrain, rocks, foliage, and ambient structures, this mod creates a warm, balanced environment where champions, abilities, and visual effects stand out instantly.
